Select molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, canonical_smiles
Join molecule_dictionary m on m.molregno = r.molregno
Join compound_records r on r.molregno = m.molregno
Join docs d on r.doc_id = d.doc_id
Filter d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1122107'
Left Join compound_structures s on s.molregno = m.molregno
Order by molecule_chembl_id
